_comment: Table for scripts/checks/sanity-fetch-options.mts. buildSanityFetchOptions() is a PURE exported function in sanity/lib/fetch.ts (no next/* imports) so tsx can call it. SANITY_REVALIDATE_SECONDS is an exported constant, value 60 (equals every page's `export const revalidate = 60`; do not raise it without Brad, see spec.md section Needs Brad).
invariants: a draft read never carries next.revalidate and always carries cache:'no-store'
a live read never carries next.revalidate and always carries cache:'no-store'
a normal published read always carries next.revalidate === SANITY_REVALIDATE_SECONDS
tags default to ['sanity'] exactly as today so app/api/revalidate keeps matching
